payload.body:
- Added Python native `logging` configuration to the evaluation module to capture fallback alerts without disrupting the CI pipeline execution.
- Implemented robust input validation guard clauses inside `_catalog_coverage` to safely intercept empty recommendation sequence blocks and prevent mathematical breakdowns.
- Added explicit parameter safeguards to neutralize zero or negative denominator conditions (`catalog_size <= 0`), returning a standardized fallback value of 0.0.
- Wrapped processing routines in structured try/except blocks to gracefully handle unexpected sparse user profiles during automated cold-start test iterations.

Closes #1590

* Added coverage for database query success and failure scenarios.
* Confirmed CI checks are passing after resolving repository-wide issues encountered during validation.

Looking forward to any feedback. Thanks!

Adds a new Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF) recommender (PyTorch-based) and wires it into the backend so collaborative recommendations can switch between classic CF and NCF, with basic pytest coverage. **Changes:** - Introduce `NeuralCollaborativeRecommender` (NCF) model with item-item and user-personalized recommendations. - Add unit tests for initialization and core NCF APIs. - Update backend and model exports to use/choose the NCF recommender; adjust Hybrid bandit methods/weights handling. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/test_neural_collaborative.py | Adds basic pytest checks for the new NCF recommender API. | | src/model/neural_collaborative_model.py | Implements the new PyTorch-based Neural Collaborative Filtering recommender. | | src/model/hybrid_model.py | Modifies bandit arm selection / reward update and affects how weights are chosen in hybrid recommend(). | | src/model/__init__.py | Exposes `NeuralCollaborativeRecommender` via safe loader and `__all__`. | | backend/main.py | Integrates NCF into request-time model construction with `USE_NCF` flag. |

payload.author: angelina-2206
payload.body:
Hi @leonagoel and team! This PR is ready for review.

Here's a quick summary of everything included:

---

### Core Feature — Knowledge Graph Embeddings
- Implemented `KnowledgeGraphRecommender` in `src/model/knowledge_graph.py` using a **NumPy-based TransE model** that learns entity embeddings from item relationships (categories, rating levels, sentiment levels, co-purchase patterns).
- Integrated it into `HybridRecommender` as a **4th scoring component** via a new `delta` weight (defaults to `0.0` — fully backward compatible, existing behaviour unchanged).
- Added `kg_score` to all recommendation result dicts and updated `_build_explanation()` with a `knowledge_graph` breakdown entry.
- Wired up `delta` in the `WeightsUpdate` schema and `PUT /api/weights` endpoint.

---

### Bug Fixes (found during implementation)
- **Weight override bug**: The upstream `recommend()` method called `_get_active_weights()` but then immediately overwrote the returned values with raw base weights, silently ignoring all weight matrix overrides. Fixed.
- **Query item exclusion**: `ContentRecommender` fallback padding was including the query item itself. Fixed.
- **Missing routes**: Upstream commit had truncated ~1500 lines from `backend/main.py`. All routes restored + new `/api/recommendations/{item_id}/explanation` XAI endpoint added.
- **Flake8 lint**: Removed duplicate `get_trending_products` definition and added missing `global TRENDING_CACHE` declaration.

---

### Tests
- `tests/test_knowledge_graph.py` — 4 new tests (triple indexing, TransE training & similarity, hybrid integration, API `/api/build` with KG)
- `tests/fixtures/ranking_golden.json` — Regenerated to reflect the corrected (bug-fixed) ranking behaviour
- All existing suites pass: `test_models.py` (35/35), `test_e2e_api_suite.py` (9/9), `test_ranking_stability.py` (8/8)

---

### Commit hygiene
- Exactly **1 clean commit** on top of current `main` — no history bloat.

Would appreciate a review when you get a chance! Happy to make any changes. 🙏

git fetch upstream

git rebase --continue
git push --force-with-lease

payload.body:
Hey @leonagoel ,
Both failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this PR:
PEP8 Lint - all flake8 errors are in files I did not touch. The only new entry from my changes is:
backend/main.py:1277:5: F841 local variable 'safe_path' is assigned to but never used
This is intentional as safe_path documents the isolated directory intent and future-proofs the code for when file saving is implemented. All other errors are pre-existing.
End-to-End API Test Suite -all 9 errors are:
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sentence_transformers'
This is a missing dependency in the CI environment, completely unrelated to this fix.
Pre-existing bug -NameError: _admin_access_dep is not defined (lines 1353, 1447, 1909, 1952, 1983) prevents test_upload_validation.py from running. This exists on main before this PR.

Hey @gopuvarshini14 👋

Thanks for the PR on fixing race condition recommendations! However, `backend/main.py` has **7 conflicts** — this is too many to safely resolve via the GitHub web editor. Please resolve locally using the command line:

```bash
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
```

For the conflicts you'll encounter:
- **Import conflicts** → keep **both sides** (don't drop any imports from either branch)
- **Logic/code conflicts** → keep **your changes** (your race condition fix) while incorporating any new code from `main`

```bash
# After fixing each conflict:
git add backend/main.py
git rebase --continue
git push origin fix-race-condition-recommendations --force
```

> ⚠️ With 7 conflicts, resolving in the web editor risks accidentally deleting code. Local resolution gives you full control and lets you test before pushing.

Ping here once done and I'll review right away! 🙌

payload.author: leonagoel
payload.body:
📢 **Important PR Guidelines for All Contributors**

Hey everyone! 👋 We've noticed a few common issues in recent pull requests. Please read carefully before submitting or updating your PRs:

---

⚠️ **1. Always sync your fork before opening a PR**
Many PRs are coming in with merge conflicts because your branch is behind `main`. Before pushing, always run:
```bash
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
git push origin your-branch --force
```
A PR with unresolved conflicts **cannot be reviewed or merged.**

---

🔴 **CRITICAL: Sync your fork on GitHub BEFORE cloning or making changes**
This is the **#1 reason** we are seeing PRs with 60+ files changed — contributors are working on a stale fork that is weeks or months behind `main`.

**Before you touch any code, do this every single time:**
1. Go to your forked repo on GitHub
2. Click **"Sync fork"** → **"Update branch"**
3. Then clone/pull the latest code locally

> 💡 If your PR shows more files changed than you actually edited — your fork was not synced. Please close the PR, sync your fork, and reopen.

---

📦 **2. One PR = One Feature / One Fix**
Please do NOT combine multiple features or fixes in a single PR.
✅ Good: `fix: date filter bug`
✅ Good: `feat: add E2E tests`
❌ Bad: `E2E testing + response time middleware fix + styling changes`

If your PR has **more than ~5–6 files changed**, it's likely doing too much. Split it up!

---

📝 **3. Write meaningful PR titles and descriptions**
Tell us:
- What did you change?
- Why did you change it?
- How did you test it?

---

Following these guidelines helps your PR get reviewed and merged **faster**, and keeps your GSSoC points coming! 🚀
Feel free to ask if you have any doubts. We're here to help 🙌

payload.author: leonagoel
payload.body:
📢 **Important PR Guidelines for All Contributors**

Hey everyone! 👋 We've noticed a few common issues in recent pull requests. Please read carefully before submitting or updating your PRs:

---

⚠️ **1. Always sync your fork before opening a PR**
Many PRs are coming in with merge conflicts because your branch is behind `main`. Before pushing, always run:
```bash
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
git push origin your-branch --force
```
A PR with unresolved conflicts **cannot be reviewed or merged.**

---

🔴 **CRITICAL: Sync your fork on GitHub BEFORE cloning or making changes**
This is the **#1 reason** we are seeing PRs with 60+ files changed — contributors are working on a stale fork that is weeks or months behind `main`.

**Before you touch any code, do this every single time:**
1. Go to your forked repo on GitHub
2. Click **"Sync fork"** → **"Update branch"**
3. Then clone/pull the latest code locally

> 💡 If your PR shows more files changed than you actually edited — your fork was not synced. Please close the PR, sync your fork, and reopen.

---

📦 **2. One PR = One Feature / One Fix**
Please do NOT combine multiple features or fixes in a single PR.
✅ Good: `fix: date filter bug`
✅ Good: `feat: add E2E tests`
❌ Bad: `E2E testing + response time middleware fix + styling changes`

If your PR has **more than ~5–6 files changed**, it's likely doing too much. Split it up!

---

📝 **3. Write meaningful PR titles and descriptions**
Tell us:
- What did you change?
- Why did you change it?
- How did you test it?

---

Following these guidelines helps your PR get reviewed and merged **faster**, and keeps your GSSoC points coming! 🚀
Feel free to ask if you have any doubts. We're here to help 🙌

payload.author: leonagoel
payload.body:
📢 **Important PR Guidelines for All Contributors**

Hey everyone! 👋 We've noticed a few common issues in recent pull requests. Please read carefully before submitting or updating your PRs:

---

⚠️ **1. Always sync your fork before opening a PR**
Many PRs are coming in with merge conflicts because your branch is behind `main`. Before pushing, always run:
```bash
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
git push origin your-branch --force
```
A PR with unresolved conflicts **cannot be reviewed or merged.**

---

🔴 **CRITICAL: Sync your fork on GitHub BEFORE cloning or making changes**
This is the **#1 reason** we are seeing PRs with 60+ files changed — contributors are working on a stale fork that is weeks or months behind `main`.

**Before you touch any code, do this every single time:**
1. Go to your forked repo on GitHub
2. Click **"Sync fork"** → **"Update branch"**
3. Then clone/pull the latest code locally

> 💡 If your PR shows more files changed than you actually edited — your fork was not synced. Please close the PR, sync your fork, and reopen.

---

📦 **2. One PR = One Feature / One Fix**
Please do NOT combine multiple features or fixes in a single PR.
✅ Good: `fix: date filter bug`
✅ Good: `feat: add E2E tests`
❌ Bad: `E2E testing + response time middleware fix + styling changes`

If your PR has **more than ~5–6 files changed**, it's likely doing too much. Split it up!

---

📝 **3. Write meaningful PR titles and descriptions**
Tell us:
- What did you change?
- Why did you change it?
- How did you test it?

---

Following these guidelines helps your PR get reviewed and merged **faster**, and keeps your GSSoC points coming! 🚀
Feel free to ask if you have any doubts. We're here to help 🙌

payload.body:
Hey @Jenisish 👋

Thanks for working on the Redis cache client initialization! I can see you're in the process of resolving conflicts in `backend/main.py` — good start! But before we can review and merge, the conflicts need to be resolved **correctly**. Here's what to do:

---

### ⚠️ Conflict in `backend/main.py` — 4 conflicts to fix

For the **imports conflict** (lines 59–64), you need to **keep both** — do NOT pick one side and discard the other:

```python
# ✅ Correct resolution - keep all imports from both sides
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from redis import Redis
```

Remove all conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`) after resolving.

---

### 🛠️ Recommended: Resolve locally (more reliable than web editor for 4 conflicts)

```bash
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
# manually fix conflicts in backend/main.py
git add backend/main.py
git rebase --continue
git push origin fix/redis --force
```

---

Please update the PR once all 4 conflicts are cleanly resolved with no conflict markers remaining. Happy to review right after! 🙌

payload.body:
## Pull request overview

> [!NOTE]
> Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review.

This PR significantly expands API capabilities and performance by adding database-side RPCs/migrations for trending/categories, enhancing caching/metrics, and introducing new recommendation controls (fairness/diversity/cold-start/knowledge-graph), alongside broad new/updated automated tests and some frontend UX improvements.

**Changes:**
- Add Supabase migrations/RPCs for trending aggregation and distinct categories retrieval (plus indexing) to reduce payload and improve scalability.
- Rework API response caching and metrics, add cold-start endpoint, and extend recommendation logic (fairness/diversity/serendipity, knowledge-graph scaffolding).

Resolve the conflict, then:

git add .github/pull_request_template.md
git commit -m "resolve merge conflict with main"
git push

Thanks! 😊

payload.body: ## Pull request overview > [!NOTE] > Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review. Adjusts Bayesian scoring for popular fallback items by passing a computed global average rating into the Bayesian rating function. **Changes:** - Computes `global_avg` from the candidate fallback dataframe’s ratings. - Passes `global_avg` into `bayesian_rating(...)` when computing `_bayesian`. --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.

payload.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
payload.body:
## Pull request overview

> [!NOTE]
> Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review.

This PR expands the recommender system with additional recommendation capabilities (cold-start, diversity/serendipity, knowledge-graph scoring), adds new evaluation metrics and database search functions, and significantly broadens automated test coverage across API, models, and utilities.

**Changes:**
- Added new recommendation features (cold-start endpoint, diversity/serendipity reranking, KG recommender) and cache/metrics endpoints.
- Introduced Supabase migrations for feedback storage and fuzzy search functions, plus CI/test-suite expansions.
- Updated frontend search UX (clear button, improved dropdown interactions) and added many new/updated tests.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 57 out of 60 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| tests/test_trending.py | Adds trending edge-case tests (negative ratings, missing details). |
| tests/test_schemas.py | Adds Pydantic schema validation tests. |
| tests/test_request_level_cache.py | Adds request-level cache behavior test for recommend endpoint. |
| tests/test_recommend_api.py | Adds user-based recommendations tests and hybrid mock updates. |
| tests/test_rate_limiting.py | Adds rate-limit scope tests for feedback + GitHub webhook; adjusts hybrid mock signature. |
| tests/test_propensity_model.py | Adds unit tests for PropensityModel edge cases. |
| tests/test_preprocessing.py | Adds preprocessing tests for normalization + NaN handling. |
| tests/test_nlp_engine.py | Adds unit tests for sentiment label/batch/aggregation behavior. |
| tests/test_models.py | Minor whitespace/format adjustment. |
| tests/test_knowledge_graph_model.py | Adds KG recommender smoke test. |
| tests/test_issue_triage.py | Reworks triage tests; adds Issue #625 edge cases and GitHub actions validation. |
| tests/test_feedback.py | Expands feedback tests and adds Supabase insert fakes. |
| tests/test_feature_store.py | Adds tests for embedding feature store persistence API. |
| tests/test_fairness_aware.py | Adds tests for fairness-aware reranking in HybridRecommender. |
| tests/test_evaluation_metrics_helpers.py | Adds evaluation helper edge-case tests (precision/recall/dcg/ndcg). |
| tests/test_e2e_api_suite.py | Adjusts E2E expectations to dict-based responses and broader status allowances. |
| tests/test_diversity_serendipity.py | Adds standalone diversity/serendipity tests (currently duplicates logic). |
| tests/test_data_adapter_validation.py | Greatly expands validation/adaptation unit tests and adds helper coverage. |
| tests/test_data_adapter.py | Adds additional _has_blank_values tests. |
| tests/test_dashboard.py | Adds dashboard fail-closed test when admin token is unset. |
| tests/test_content_based.py | Adds catalog-filter, explain_similarity, and batch-size tests. |
| tests/test_collaborative.py | Updates cold-start behavior expectation for collaborative model. |
| tests/test_cold_start_and_cache.py | Adds cold-start endpoint + cache metrics tests. |
| tests/test_causal_model.py | Adds propensity + debiaser extreme clip tests. |
| tests/test_causal_config.py | Adds CausalConfig validation/preset tests. |
| tests/test_bayesian_rating.py | Adds bayesian_rating edge-case tests. |
| tests/test_api_cache.py | Updates hybrid mock signature and response-shape assertions. |
| supabase/migrations/003_create_feedback_submissions.sql | Creates feedback_submissions table and indexes; enables RLS. |
| supabase/migrations/002_create_products_table.sql | Refactors products schema + adds pg_trgm and fuzzy/standard search functions. |
| src/model/two_tower_retrieval.py | Converts lambda forward into proper module methods; fixes FAISS id mapping. |
| src/model/nlp_engine.py | Adds compute_product_sentiment fallback helper. |
| src/model/llm_exp
